source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 1–8 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 186 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Follows qere they crossed and notes ketiv we crossed; preserves the two king groups and returning heart/spirit images.
Retains the second-time wording, allowing the following generation explanation rather than inserting a solution into the command.
Retains forty years, the two oaths, and the source’s shift to us instead of harmonizing its voice.
Keeps the rolling/Gilgal wordplay in a note and leaves the disgrace’s precise referent open.
Keeps the next-day sequence, cessation repeated, and transition to local produce without importing a festival calculation.
Keeps the abrupt No and the commander’s title without adding a doctrinal identity or replacing his reply with a paraphrased allegiance claim.
